components.name: DtChart
components.runtimeNotes: Theme prop validator has bug — see package-runtime.md section 9. Requires showTheme=true + theme prop for themed init. Fallback i18n injection needed before mount.
components.description: Wraps echarts.init() + setOption. Supports all echarts series types. Uses echarts.registerTheme for theme.

components.name: BarChart
components.description: Three.js-based 3D bar chart class. Constructor(dom, data, config). Has setTheme(light|dark).

components.name: DtBarChartThree
components.runtimeNotes: OVERWRITES window.onresize on mount, sets null on unmount. Will conflict with other resize listeners.
components.description: Vue wrapper for 3D bar chart. Props: options, theme (default 'dark'). Emits: page-change, after-bar-click, bar-mouse-hover.

components.name: DtTopoThree
components.runtimeNotes: Requires ~8MB external resources (glb models, Draco WASM, bg images). Not tested without these assets.
components.description: Three.js-based 3D device topology. Props: options, useSuper. Emits: loaded, click-model, hover-model.
externalResources: 3D model .glb files (~50-650KB each, ~2MB total: npu-*.glb, server-*.glb, leaf-*.glb, spine-*.glb, roce-*.glb)

components.name: DtClusterTopo
components.description: G6-based 2D topology. Props: data, tooltipContent, clickMenus, topoNEStyle. Emits: click-menu, selected-change.

components.name: DtRelationTopo
components.description: G6-based relation graph. Props: nodeId, etc. Emits: various topo events.

components.name: DtInferTopo
components.description: G6-based inference topology. Uses InferGraph, PolyBox custom node.

components.name: DtPointBezier
components.runtimeNotes: Uses resolveDirective('click-outside') — requires manual vClickOutside registration if not using app.use(SweetUI).
components.description: SVG Bezier relation between trigger/target points. Props: relation, triggerData, targetData, fill, stroke, strokeWidth.

components.name: DtCustomBarChart
components.description: CSS horizontal bar chart. Props: option (yData, seriesData, xMax).

components.name: DtDashboardDesigner
components.runtimeNotes: Uses inject('sweetI18n') extensively. Requires i18n provide.
components.description: Drag-and-drop dashboard designer with grid system.

sweetUiBaseChartComponents.note: These are in @hw-seq/sweet-ui-base (not dt-ui). Listed for completeness. Available when sweet-ui-base is installed.

dualSweetUiBase.description: dt-ui nests sweet-ui-base 5.6.5 causing dual Vue instances
dualSweetUiBase.fix: resolve.dedupe + remove nested copy + clear vite cache

sweetI18nInjection.description: inject('sweetI18n') fails without provide before mount

clickOutsideDirective.description: resolveDirective('click-outside') fails when SweetUI installer not used

themeValidatorBug.description: ["", Object.keys(THEME_MAP)].includes(val) creates nested array, never validates

pluginMustBeFunction.description: An entry in dt-ui Components array lacks install method

windowOnresizeOverwrite.description: DtBarChartThree overwrites window.onresize, sets null on unmount
windowOnresizeOverwrite.fix: Avoid DtBarChartThree alongside other resize listeners, or use addEventListener
